officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails: 2. Stensjön - Skatås
findings: Current official stage name is Stensjön - Skatås.
Distance 9 km, estimated time 3 h, difficulty blue/medium.
Surface is a mix of dirt road, forest path, and a little asphalt road.
Large parts follow even-surfaced woodland paths, with a couple of shorter steeper parts.
Stages 2-6 are part of STF Signaturled Göteborg.
Official text mentions Norra Långevattnet rest/picnic spot, Delsjön swimming/canoeing, Skatås running tracks, cafe and toilets, and Stora Torp as a side visit.
Official access text says there is parking at Stensjön, names Kristinedal bus stop just north of the start, and names Welandersgatan/Welandergatan for bus/tram near Skatås.

findings: Track has 1296 raw points and 432 unique consecutive points after de-duplication.

GPX Last-Modified observed as 2024-11-26T20:31:53Z.
GPX repeats many consecutive coordinates; normalization should de-duplicate before length or QA processing.

findings: Page-embedded tokenized API returns a GeoJSON LineString matching the official GPX.

Bare API without page token returned 401 Unauthorized; do not store page token as a stable source.

officialSources.title: Naturkartan: Stensjön - Skatås, Bohusleden, etapp 2
findings: Page lists length 8.3 km, time 4 h, and difficulty Blue - medium.
Text describes a little over eight kilometers, starting by Stensjön, crossing road 40 northward, and entering Delsjöområdet nature reserve in Göteborg municipality.
Naturkartan GPX has 830 raw points, 292 unique consecutive points, and computed length about 8.303 km.
Naturkartan GPX starts about 16.3 m from the official WST start and ends at the same official endpoint.
Geometry is useful corroboration but planning-grade relative to WST/OSM because it is shorter and more generalized.

officialSources.title: Västsverige / Mölndal: Bohusleden etapp 2
findings: Lists Stensjön - Skatås as 8 km, medium, about 2-3 h.
Describes the route from Stensjön in Mölndal via Gunnebo slott to Skatås in Delsjöområdets naturreservat.

Mentions Norra Långevattnet rest area, Delsjöområdet, Skatås motionscentrum cafe, Delsjöområdets natursal, accommodation at Lisebergsbyn, canoeing, swimming, frisbee golf, beach volleyball, and Stora Torp side trip.

officialSources.title: STF Lerum-Partille: Bohusleden etapp 2 Stensjön - Skatås
findings: A 2026-03-01 STF local hike page describes this as etapp 1 of STF Signaturled Göteborg.
Confirms Norra Långvattnet and Delsjöns naturreservat, smooth forest paths, easy-to-medium terrain, a couple of short steeper passages, approximately 9 km, and about 4 hours with group pace/rest.
Names Gunnebo Park bus stop and bus 754 from Heden or Mölndals bro as meeting access.

officialSources.title: Länsstyrelsen: Delsjöområdet nature reserve
findings: Bohusleden passes through or is explicitly associated with Delsjöområdet.
Rules include no camping/caravans, fire only at designated places, motor vehicles only on allowed roads, no motorboats, and riding only on permitted roads/trails.
Delsjöarna are a Göteborg water source; petrol motors are not allowed.

officialSources.title: Länsstyrelsen: Gunnebo cultural reserve
findings: Gunnebo rules are relevant to the start/access area if the GPX or access paths overlap the cultural reserve.
Rules include no camping/tent/wind shelter/caravan, fire only at designated places, dogs on leash/no loose dogs, and motor vehicles only on public roads/parking.

bathingAndWaterSafety.summary: Stora Delsjön is an EU bathing site with beach/cliffs/docks/toilets. Latest available 2025 bathing-water classification for the 2026 season was excellent, and official 2026 sampling season was listed as 2026-06-21 to 2026-08-20.
bathingAndWaterSafety.confidence: high for latest available official bathing-water record
caveats: Do not present April 2026 as sampled bathing water; recheck during bathing season.

bathingAndWaterSafety.summary: Mölndal municipal bathing places including Rådasjön and Stensjön have dog bans on bathing-place areas 1 April-30 September with exceptions, fishing bans at bathing places, and rescue-access/lifesaving-equipment notes.
caveats: Applies to bathing-place areas and detours/access points, not necessarily the walking tread.

huntingForestry.summary: No route-specific hunting or forestry alert was found. General Naturvårdsverket guidance says hunting signs do not legally close allemansrätt access, but visitors should avoid the area or show necessary consideration; intentionally disturbing hunting is prohibited. Skogsstyrelsen has notified-felling map services for pre-publication checks.
caveats: Urban/protected route makes major forestry risk lower, but municipal works and forestry map services should be rechecked before publication.

closuresAndReroutes.summary: No official Stage 2 closure/reroute was visible on West Sweden Trails or Naturkartan stage pages during the 2026-04-29 pass. Länsstyrelsen Delsjö/Gunnebo pages showed no local news apart from county-level fire-risk messaging.
caveats: Record as no alert found, not proof that no local temporary issue exists; recheck WST report/deviation page, map planner and Naturkartan before release.

lanes.summary: Confirmed WST canonical facts, official route description, access notes, WST place inventory, Delsjöområdet/Gunnebo/Rådasjön protected-area handling, and distance contradictions.
Validated official GPX/API, Naturkartan GPX, OSM relation 279634 and parent superroute; recommended official GPX as navigation-grade after de-duplication.
Produced structured facility records with coordinates, proximity, confidence and import/pending/suppress decisions.
Identified Gunnebo Park and Welandergatan as high-confidence endpoint transit points; documented parking and transfer hubs.
Found recent 2025 good-condition reports and no credible current closure; preserved low-confidence 2026 Delsjön pier note as facility-only.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Stage 2 is ready for later normalization with caveats. No targeted second agent batch needed because geometry, endpoint coordinates, access, rules, field reports and high-priority facilities are all well-supported. Remaining caveats are normal pre-import QA: reserve polygon overlay, live fire/closure/timetable checks, and facility opening/season verification.
